title: Datadog or New Relic: Observability Platforms Compared
excerpt: Both are full observability platforms covering metrics, logs and traces. Datadog emphasises breadth, including security products; New Relic built its name on application performance monitoring.
verdict: Datadog is the more complete choice if you want one platform for infrastructure monitoring, logs and security. New Relic is a strong option when application performance monitoring is the main priority and you want pricing that is easier to predict.

spec1.device1Value: Very wide: monitoring, security and logs in one platform
